title: [BUG] cursor <-> claude code integration does not work from inside tmux
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.1
- Operating System: macOS 15.4
- Terminal:  Ghosttty + tmux

## Bug Description
claude code running inside tmux wont see a running cursor instance when running `/ide`. 
I also have tmux auto start in cursor terminals, and that does not recognize that it is running inside cursor

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Run cursor
2. start a tmux session 
3. run claude
4. /ide  Shows no available ides

## Expected Behavior
Show running cursor. This works if I am not inside tmux
author: ramarnat

top_comments.author: blois
top_comments.body: Exporting `TERM_PROGRAM=cursor` should make it pick up that it's in Cursor. `cursor` will also need to be in the path for it to work

top_comments.author: blois
top_comments.body:
Ah, ok. I'm seeing an error:

```
! cursor --list-extensions
  ⎿  Unable to connect to VS Code server: Error in request.
     Error: connect ENOENT /tmp/vscode-ipc-13b05293-93fa-4a98-8a0d-d62186acfa94.sock
```

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body: @ramarnat  - are you running tmux in ghostty or in cursor's terminal? you have to run it in cursor terminal (without tmux) at least once to install. After that it should work.
